name: fuse-kb
description: Ask Claude questions about your organization's documents, with answers cited to the document and page.
long_description: Search the knowledge bases you build in Fuse and download as .sqlite files. Choose the folder where you keep them, then ask Claude about your HR, payroll, finance, IT, or legal documents. Search runs on your computer: keyword search works with no setup, and search by meaning uses the model each knowledge base was built with. Text in documents that tries to give instructions to an AI is removed before Claude sees it.

tools.name: kb_list
tools.description: List the knowledge bases in your folder

tools.name: kb_research
tools.description: Search a knowledge base for passages that answer a question

tools.name: kb_search
tools.description: Search with one method: hybrid, keyword, meaning, or metadata

tools.name: kb_read_pages
tools.description: Read consecutive pages of one document

tools.name: kb_documents
tools.description: List the documents in a knowledge base

kb_folder.title: Knowledge base folder
kb_folder.description: The folder where you keep knowledge base files downloaded from Fuse (.sqlite or .sqlite.gpg).

reranker.title: Reranker (optional)
reranker.description: Improves result ordering. Leave blank for none. 'cohere' uses AWS Bedrock and needs AWS credentials.

pgp_key_file.title: PGP private key file (optional)
pgp_key_file.description: Only for encrypted downloads (.sqlite.gpg) when your key isn't in GnuPG on this computer.

pgp_passphrase.title: PGP key passphrase (optional)
pgp_passphrase.description: Only for encrypted downloads. Stored securely by Claude.
